environment_setting: Country B, City X, a bustling urban area with occasional civil unrest due to political tensions.
norm_base: Peace Officers Receiving notice of a riot within their jurisdiction and failing without reasonable excuse to take steps to suppress it Imprisonment up to 2 years or punishable on summary conviction

legitimate.legitimate_action: Responding promptly to the riot and taking steps to suppress it
legitimate.benefits: Maintains public safety, upholds professional duty, avoids legal consequences
legitimate.costs: Physical risk, emotional stress, potential backlash from rioters

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring the riot notice and failing to take action
illegal.benefits: Avoids immediate physical danger and stress, saves time
illegal.costs: Imprisonment up to 2 years or punishable on summary conviction, loss of job and reputation
